title: kith-events: TypeFilter silently drops unknown type names in allows()
description: TypeFilter::allows() has a comment: 'Unknown type names are silently dropped. Note: TypeFilter::parse() rejects unknown names at the query parameter level, so this arm is [unreachable in practice].' But allows() is also called with type_name values from the live broadcast StateChange events (which come from the store layer, not the client). If the store ever emits a StateChange with a type_name that is not ChatContact/Chat/Message (e.g. 'Attachment'), that event is silently discarded with no error or log. The comment says this path is unreachable but there is no debug_assert or compile-time guarantee. If a future type is added to StateChange emission but not to TypeFilter::allows(), it will be silently dropped for all filtered connections.
